requirement_text: A patient shall book an available appointment with a selected doctor.
A patient shall reschedule an existing appointment to another available consultation slot.
A patient shall cancel a confirmed appointment before the cancellation deadline.
A patient shall search for a doctor by specialty and clinic location.
A doctor shall create a prescription after a completed consultation.
A doctor shall update the status of an appointment after completing a consultation.
An administrator shall review audit events for suspicious access activity.
The system shall notify a patient when an appointment is confirmed.
A customer shall add a product to the shopping cart.
A customer shall remove an item from the shopping cart.
A customer shall place an order for the products in the shopping cart.
A customer shall cancel an order that has not been shipped.
A customer shall search for a product by name, category, or brand.
A seller shall create a new product listing.
A seller shall update the stock quantity of a product.
An administrator shall approve a seller registration request.
A bank customer shall transfer funds to another registered account.
A bank customer shall view the current balance of an account.
A bank customer shall download a monthly bank statement.
A bank customer shall pay a utility bill from a selected account.
A bank officer shall approve a loan application after verification.
A bank officer shall reject an incomplete loan application.
A bank customer shall block a lost payment card.
The system shall notify a bank customer of a high-value transaction.
A member shall borrow an available book.
A member shall return a borrowed book.
A member shall reserve a book that is currently unavailable.
A member shall search for a book by title, author, or ISBN.
A librarian shall add a new book to the catalog.
A librarian shall update the catalog details of a book.
A librarian shall remove a damaged book from circulation.
The system shall notify a member when a reserved book becomes available.
A student shall enroll in an available course.
A student shall drop a course before the academic deadline.
A student shall submit an assignment before the due date.
A lecturer shall grade a submitted assignment.
A lecturer shall publish the final grade for a course.
A student shall view the timetable for enrolled courses.
An administrator shall create a new academic semester.
An administrator shall assign a lecturer to a course.
An employee shall request annual leave for selected dates.
An HR manager shall approve an eligible leave request.
An HR manager shall reject a leave request with a reason.
An employee shall update personal contact information.
An employee shall view the monthly payslip.
An HR manager shall create a job vacancy.
A recruiter shall review a submitted job application.
A recruiter shall schedule an interview for a shortlisted candidate.
A traveler shall search for a flight by origin, destination, and date.
A traveler shall book an available flight.
A traveler shall cancel an eligible flight booking.
A traveler shall reschedule a flight booking to another available flight.
A traveler shall select a seat for a confirmed flight booking.
A traveler shall pay for a flight booking using a supported payment method.
An agent shall create a travel package.
An agent shall update the price of a travel package.
A dispatcher shall create a delivery order for a customer shipment.
A dispatcher shall assign a driver to a delivery order.
A driver shall accept an assigned delivery order.
A driver shall update the status of a delivery order.
A customer shall track the current location of a shipment.
A customer shall cancel a delivery request before dispatch.
A dispatcher shall reschedule a delayed delivery.
The system shall notify a customer when a shipment is delivered.
